# AppHub Logo Handoff

## Share This Version

This document now includes the actual icon bytes in the self-contained HTML example at the end. Sharing this Markdown alone is sufficient: copy that complete example into an HTML file. No Flask server, external image, JavaScript, or network request is required.

For normal project integration, use the accompanying ZIP, which includes this guide, a runnable preview, and both original PNG files. Do not use the earlier path-only handoff.

## Critical: Reuse the Exact Icon Asset

Do **not** generate, redraw, reinterpret, or rename this mark. The expected icon is the existing `static/img/apphub_icon.png` file. Copy that exact PNG into the other project's assets and render it as an image. Do not substitute a generated "InnovationHub" logo, a stack of differently arranged tiles, or text baked into the mark. The wordmark is separate from the icon.

The icon below is the visual target (icon only, no wordmark):

![Exact AppHub icon asset: cyan/blue diamond cluster with smaller colored diamonds below](static/img/apphub_icon.png)

The preview above uses a relative path and may not display in another chat. The self-contained example below embeds the exact PNG as a Base64 data URL instead. Alternatively, the ZIP supplies the physical PNG at the same relative path. Do not invent a replacement when a Markdown renderer suppresses the preview.

Use this guide to reproduce the AppHub 4.0 logo lockup in another app or session. The source of truth is the existing PNG artwork plus the HTML/CSS below; do not redraw, replace, or rename the brand artwork.

## Source Assets

Copy the needed PNG asset(s) into the destination project's static/public assets directory:

- [Icon-only mark](static/img/apphub_icon.png) — 509 x 418 px. This exact multicolor diamond-cluster PNG is the icon used in the live AppHub navigation lockup and matches the reference above. Preserve its original colors, transparency, aspect ratio, and geometry.
- [Full logo artwork](static/img/apphub_logo.png) — 1080 x 1080 px. This is a standalone square image containing the geometric mark and APPHUB wordmark. Use when an image-only lockup is needed; it is not the asset used by the live navigation header.

The live header assembles this exact icon with HTML text. This keeps the wordmark crisp and allows its color to follow the navigation theme. Prefer that approach when reproducing the AppHub shell. Do not apply CSS filters that recolor the mark.

## Live Lockup

### HTML

For Flask/Jinja, use `url_for` for the asset URL and pass the existing app version. For a non-Flask project, replace the image `src` with that project's static path and replace `{{ version }}` with the desired version string or remove the badge.

```html
<div class="nav-logo">
  <img
    src="{{ url_for('static', filename='img/apphub_icon.png') }}"
    alt="AppHub Logo"
    class="logo-img">
  <div class="logo-text-block">
    <div class="logo-text"><span class="logo-bold">APP</span><span class="logo-light">HUB</span></div>
    <span class="version-badge">v{{ version }}</span>
  </div>
</div>
```

### CSS

These are the logo rules used in `static/css/apphub.css`:

```css
.nav-logo {
  font-family: 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: row;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 20px;
}

.logo-img {
  width: 58px;
  height: auto;
}

.logo-text-block {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1px;
  line-height: 1;
}

.logo-text {
  font-size: 0.98rem;
  letter-spacing: 1.5px;
  color: var(--nav-text);
  line-height: 1;
}

.logo-bold {
  font-weight: 700;
}

.logo-light {
  font-weight: 300;
}

.version-badge {
  font-size: 0.6rem;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  opacity: 0.85;
  font-weight: 500;
  letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}
```

The parent navigation header in the current shell provides `min-height: 54px`, `padding: 9px 14px`, and flex alignment. The logo itself does not set a fixed height; preserve the icon's natural aspect ratio.

## Theme Behavior

The wordmark uses `var(--nav-text)` so it follows the shell theme. Define that variable on the navigation/theme root:

```css
:root,
[data-theme="dark"] {
  --nav-text: #e2e8f0;
  --text-secondary: #94a3b8;
}

[data-theme="medium"] {
  --nav-text: #f1f5f9;
  --text-secondary: #4b5563;
}

[data-theme="light"] {
  --nav-text: #1e293b;
  --text-secondary: #475569;
}
```

The live shell includes this light-theme rule; keep it if copying the same CSS:

```css
[data-theme="light"] .logo-img {
  filter: none;
}
```

Do not hardcode the wordmark to white: that makes it unreadable in Light mode. Use the theme variable.

## Collapsed Navigation

In AppHub, the navigation collapses to icon-only mode, so the complete logo lockup is hidden rather than squeezed or clipped:

```css
.nav-collapsed .nav-logo {
  display: none;
}
```

The expanded navigation shows the full lockup. Keep the icon-only asset available for any separate collapsed-state or app-icon use.

## Standalone Image Use

If the destination needs a single image rather than the theme-aware HTML lockup, use `apphub_logo.png`:

```html
<img src="/static/img/apphub_logo.png" alt="AppHub" class="apphub-full-logo">
```

```css
.apphub-full-logo {
  display: block;
  width: min(100%, 240px);
  height: auto;
  object-fit: contain;
}
```

Check contrast against the destination background before using the full image. For a navigation header that supports both dark and light themes, use the icon-only PNG plus live text instead.

## Reproduction Steps

1. Copy the exact `apphub_icon.png` from `static/img/` into the other project's static assets. Optionally copy `apphub_logo.png` only if a single-file full lockup is required.
2. Add the HTML lockup and logo CSS above, keeping the icon as an `<img>` that references the copied original PNG.
3. Define `--nav-text` and `--text-secondary` for each theme; use the current values above to match AppHub 4.0.
4. Keep the 58px icon width, 20px horizontal gap, 0.98rem wordmark size, and 1.5px letter spacing for the same proportions.
5. Add the collapsed-nav rule if the destination has an icon-only collapsed state.
6. Test the logo against every supported theme and at the collapsed/expanded navigation widths. Compare the icon's tile arrangement and colors with the inline reference above; do not accept a generated or substituted mark.

## Self-Contained Runnable Example

Copy the entire block below into `apphub-logo-preview.html` and open it in a browser. Its image data is the original `apphub_icon.png`, not a generated approximation. Remove `.logo-text-block` if only the icon is wanted. To preview other themes, change `data-theme="dark"` to `medium` or `light`.

The example assumes the browser's default 16px root size. Segoe UI is normally available on Windows; other platforms use the listed fallbacks and may have different text metrics. The PNG geometry and colors are independent of fonts. No font file is bundled.

If Content Security Policy blocks `data:` images, use the PNG from the ZIP and change the image URL to `static/img/apphub_icon.png`; do not relax the application's security policy merely to use this example.

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en" data-theme="dark">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <title>AppHub Logo Preview</title>
  <style>
    :root { --nav-bg:#0f1729; --nav-text:#e2e8f0; --text-secondary:#94a3b8; }
    [data-theme="medium"] { --nav-bg:#2d3748; --nav-text:#f1f5f9; --text-secondary:#4b5563; }
    [data-theme="light"] { --nav-bg:#e2e8f0; --nav-text:#1e293b; --text-secondary:#475569; }
    * { box-sizing:border-box; }
    body { margin:0; font-family:'Segoe UI',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif; background:var(--nav-bg); }
    .nav-header { padding:9px 14px; min-height:54px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22); }
    [data-theme="light"] .nav-header { border-bottom-color:#e5e7eb; }
    .nav-logo { display:flex; flex-direction:row; align-items:center; gap:20px; }
    .logo-img { width:58px; height:auto; filter:none; }
    .logo-text-block { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:1px; line-height:1; }
    .logo-text { font-size:.98rem; letter-spacing:1.5px; color:var(--nav-text); line-height:1; }
    .logo-bold { font-weight:700; }
    .logo-light { font-weight:300; }
    .version-badge { font-size:.6rem; color:var(--text-secondary); opacity:.85; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:.5px; }
    [data-theme="medium"] .version-badge { color:#64748b; opacity:1; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="nav-header">
    <div class="nav-logo">
      <img class="logo-img" alt="AppHub icon" src="data:image/png;base64,">
      <div class="logo-text-block">
        <div class="logo-text"><span class="logo-bold">APP</span><span class="logo-light">HUB</span></div>
        <span class="version-badge">v4.0</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</body>
</html>
```
